# StackedAreaChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders multiple nonnegative series as cumulative stacked area bands.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new StackedAreaChart()
new StackedAreaChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`Curve`](#curve): Curve interpolation mode for stacked area boundaries.
- [`DefaultFillOpacity`](#defaultfillopacity): Default fill opacity for stacked area bands (0 to 1).
- [`DefaultLineWidth`](#defaultlinewidth): Default stroke width for upper boundary lines in points.
- [`Mode`](#mode): Stacking mode: `absolute` (default) or 100% normalized `percent`.
